Legt immer eine <em>neue</em> Website an: Always creates a new website, never merges into an existing one. Merging would need an answer for every conflict — same address, different text — and the honest answer is a second website you can compare and then delete.
Liest den Ordner noch einmal und baut di: Reads the folder again and rebuilds the screens.
Lädt diese Website als Archiv herunter:: Downloads this website as an archive: pages, posts, menus, snippets, labels and every file. Passwords and domains never travel with it.
Löscht alles vor dem gewählten Tag, unwi: Deletes everything before the chosen day, irreversibly. The deletion itself is recorded as the next entry.
Markiert die Seite in der Seitenliste al: Marks the page as awaiting review in the page list.
Mehr Bausteinarten werden nicht angelegt: No more block kinds are created — a menu that long is one nobody reads any more.
Mehr Felder werden nicht angelegt — ein: No more fields are created — a form that long is one nobody fills in properly.
Mehr Inhaltsarten gehen nicht: No more content kinds are possible
Several fields, filled in more than once — opening hours, say.
Mit Komma getrennt. Jedes Schlagwort bek: Separated by commas. Every label gets its own overview page under /tag/…. At most twelve per entry.
Mit diesem Link kann jemand ohne Zugang: This link lets somebody without an account look at the page — even while it is still a draft. So a draft need not be published “briefly” for a client to take a look.
Name: Name
New pages always start as drafts. Nothing is published unless you ask for it explicitly — and everything the assistant writes goes through the same checks as text written in the administration: the same address rules, the same versions, editable and revertible by hand afterwards.
Nothing ticked means every website. Whoever gets a selection here sees only those from then on — everywhere, including through a copied address.
None of this stopped the import. Listed so nobody has to go through two hundred pages by hand to find it.
Noch kein Baustein. Wähle unten einen au: No block yet. Choose one below — Text is the familiar Markdown section.
Noch kein Schlüssel ausgestellt. Ohne Sc: No key issued yet. Without a key nobody gets in here.
Noch keine Einträge. Füge unten den erst: No entries yet. Add the first one below.
No menus yet. Create the first one above.
Noch keine Seiten. Lege die erste Seite: No pages yet. Create the first page to get going.
Noch keine Vorlagen. Lade die erste hoch: No templates yet. Upload the first one to get going.
Noch keine Website. Leg die erste an, um: No website yet. Create the first one to get going.
Noch keine eigenen Felder. Ohne sie hat: No fields of your own yet. Without them a page has exactly what every page has — enough for text, not enough for a product catalogue.
Nur Kleinbuchstaben, Ziffern, Bindestric: Lower-case letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.
Nur ein Pfadabschnitt, ohne Schrägstrich: Just one path segment, without a slash — for example: shop
Nur für dich: woran du später erkennst,: For you only: how you will later tell which key belongs where.
Nur für die Art „Auswahl“: eine Möglichk: For the “Choice” kind only: one option per line. Otherwise leave the field empty.
Nur mitgelieferte Schriften – eine selbs: Built-in typefaces only — one typed in by hand would either not be installed or would have to be loaded from somebody else's server.
Ohne Angabe wird gar kein Betriebs-Daten: With nothing set, no business record is shipped at all — a private diary should not pass itself off as a shop.
Ohne Beschreibung sucht sich Google selb: Without a description Google picks a passage of text itself.
Ohne Domain ist die Website nicht erreic: Without a domain the website cannot be reached.
Ohne Favicon fragt jeder Browser /favico: Without a favicon every browser asks for /favicon.ico and gets a 404.
Ohne Favicon fragt jeder Browser <code>/: Without a favicon every browser asks for /favicon.ico and gets a 404.
Ohne aktivierte Vorlage wird die mitgeli: Without an activated template the built-in default template is used.
Ohne dieses Recht wird geschrieben und z: Without this right one writes and submits for review; somebody else puts it online.
Ohne veröffentlichte Startseite antworte: Without a published start page your own domain answers “page not found”.
PNG, WebP oder SVG, höchstens 512 KB. Er: PNG, WebP or SVG, at most 512 KB. Replaces the square with the letter. An SVG is checked: script inside it is refused, not defused.
Passwort gesetzt. Bitte melde dich jetzt: Password set. Please sign in now.
Schlagwort gelöscht. Die Inhalte selbst: Label deleted. The content itself stays.
Schlagwörter fassen Inhalte über das Men: Labels gather content across the menu. Each has its own overview page under /tag/…. They are assigned while editing a page or a post.
Seite mit Passwort schützen: Protect the page with a password
Setze <code>HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_HOST</code> u: Set HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_HOST and HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_FROM and restart the service. Optional: HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_PORT (default 587), HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_USER, HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_PASSWORD, HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_FROM_NAME and HOLZCLOUD_SMTP_TLS (starttls, tls or none).
Setzt den Zuschnitt zurück. Der Punkt fü: Resets the crop. The subject point stays — it says where something is, and that holds for the uncropped image too.
That is what the button in the editor says.
So rufst du den Baustein auf: <code>[[sn: This is how you call the snippet: [[snippet:key]]
Sprachkürzel, durch Komma getrennt – zum: Language tags separated by commas — for example fr, it or fr-CH. The main language above keeps its addresses (/kontakt); every further language gets a prefix (/fr/contact). At most eight.
Steht sichtbar unter dem Bild. Darf leer: Shown visibly below the image. May stay empty.
Steht still da, bis jemand auf Abspielen: Sits still until somebody presses play. Without one, most browsers show a black rectangle.
Steht öffentlich neben dem Kontaktformul: Shown publicly beside the contact form as a direct alternative.
Shown above the list and in the filter.
Tage; 0 heißt unbegrenzt. Ein Schlüssel,: days; 0 means unlimited. A key that stops working on a Tuesday morning is one whose failure nobody can explain afterwards.
Text ansehen, beschriften oder wiederher: View the text, label it, or restore it
Textbausteine sind Inhalte, die auf mehr: Snippets are content that appears on several pages — an address, opening hours, a contact block. Write [[snippet:key]] into a page and the snippet is put in there when the page is shown. You then only have to change it once.
Trotz Verwendung löschen? Auf den betrof: Delete it even though it is in use? The pages concerned will then show a broken image.
Umbenannt. Die Adresse bleibt unveränder: Renamed. The address stays as it was so existing links keep working.
Unter dieser Adresse liegt schon eine Se: There is already a page at this address. Choose another one, otherwise one of the two would be unreachable.
Unter dieser Adresse stehen alle Beiträg: All posts live at this address, sorted by date — /news, say. Leave empty if the website needs no archive.
Veröffentlichen gehört nicht zu deinem Z: Publishing is not part of your account. Submit the page for review.
Publishing is not part of your account. Save and submit the page for review — somebody with the right will put it online.
Veröffentlichungsdaten werden in dieser: Publication dates are shown in this zone.
Vorlage herunterladen — eine JSON-Datei: Download the starter file — a JSON file with every German sentence as a key and empty values.
Weiterleitungen halten alte Adressen am: Redirects keep old addresses alive. Renaming a page creates one automatically. You can also enter the addresses of an old website here so its links keep working.
Wenn die Website nicht aktiv ist: When the website is not active
Wer nur eine Website betreuen lässt, sol: Somebody who looks after only one website should only be able to reach that one.
Werte ausfüllen. Was leer bleibt, ersche: Fill in the values. Whatever stays empty appears in German — half a translation is usable.
Wie sich diese Verwaltung nennt. Steht o: What this administration calls itself. It appears in the corner, in the window title and on the sign-in screen — everywhere that otherwise says “Holzcloud”.
Wiederherstellungscode verbraucht. Prüfe: Recovery code used up. Check under “My account” how many are left.
Wird angezeigt, wenn jemand den Link in: Shown when somebody shares the link in a messenger or a social network.
Wird benutzt, wenn eine Seite keine eige: Used when a page has no description of its own.
Wird sonst aus den ersten Sätzen des Inh: Otherwise built from the first sentences of the content
Wird sonst aus der Mediathek genommen: Otherwise taken from the media library
Wird von der Vorlage im Kopfbereich ange: Shown by the template in the header, if it supports that.
Woraus ein Baustein „%s“ besteht. Die Fe: What a “%s” block is made of. The fields appear in the block editor in this order, and in the theme each carries a class of its own.
Zeigt die Seite jemandem ohne Zugang – a: Shows the page to somebody without an account — even as a draft. So nothing has to be published “briefly” for a client to take a look.
Ziel und Quelle dürfen nicht gleich sein: Target and source must not be the same.
Zu viele Fehlversuche. Bitte warte einen: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment.
Zum Entfernen die Kennung des Plugins ei: Type the plugin's key to remove it.
Zurzeit ist kein Mailserver eingerichtet: No mail server is set up at present
Zwischen „eine von vier Vorlagen aussuch: Between “pick one of four templates” and “maintain a template of your own” sits exactly this: a handful of values every template picks up. None of them has to be set — empty means the template decides.
bleibt, auch wenn du die Beschriftung än: stays even when you change the label: otherwise the theme would suddenly face a field that no longer exists.
lässt sich nicht zuschneiden – das geht: cannot be cropped — that works for JPEG, PNG and WebP images only.
unterwegs. Er steht hier trotzdem: E-Mai: as well. It is shown here anyway: email can be delayed or land in spam, and then this is the way that certainly works.
z. B. Ein Schritt der Anleitung, mit Bil: e.g. One step of the instructions, with a picture.
z. B. in Franken, ohne Währungszeichen: e.g. in francs, without a currency symbol
§ 5 DDG verlangt ein von jeder Seite err: German law (§ 5 DDG) requires an imprint reachable from every page; the footer menu does that.
Öffne eine Authenticator-App und scanne: Open an authenticator app and scan this code.
Überschreibt die Kurzfassung in der Tref: Overrides the excerpt in the results list
„Fassung anlegen“ kopiert diese Seite al: “Create version” copies this page into the other language as a draft — text and address are translated there.
